title: Vitória: a short historical ranking pilot
claim_limit: Source-specific historical ranking evidence only; no clinical effectiveness, fairness or operational readiness established.

source.title: Medical Appointment No Shows
source.attribution: Joni Hoppen (joniarroba), with credit to Aquarela Analytics
source.notice: Retrospective analysis of Medical Appointment No Shows, version 5, shared on Kaggle by Joni Hoppen (joniarroba), with credit to Aquarela Analytics. Source data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. CareAccess applied cohort filtering, feature engineering and statistical evaluation. Only aggregate findings are shown; no source records or model weights are redistributed. No endorsement by the source contributors is implied.
source.privacy_notice: Research only. Consent, institutional release authority and anonymization documentation were not verified; the data license does not resolve privacy rights.

design.primary_capacity: floor(10% of eligible appointments) separately on each source appointment date; pooled across the released service
design.eligibility: Recorded age 18–110; valid supplied linkage keys and dates; booking date at least three source calendar days before appointment date.
design.timing: A source-calendar planning proxy, not verified real-world 48-hour availability. Historical input snapshots, timezone semantics and outcome-maturity timing were not verified.
design.selection: Three expanding, purged temporal development folds selected xgb_d3 and locked the strongest simple rule before final outcomes were opened. Final refits and predictions were frozen; one final target parse was recorded. No post-test model reselection or recalibration.
design.features: Recorded age, booking lead days and log lead days, appointment and booking weekdays, appointment month, and hospital location. Excludes identifiers, SMS timing and unverified health-condition fields from primary features.
design.patient_linkage: 12,555 supplied patient keys, not verified unique people. Appointment is the analysis unit; repeated patients can occur.

gates.C_meaning: Passed the prespecified historical ranking screen against random and the locked simple rule on this eight-date cohort.
gates.D_meaning: Failed to establish added value from boosting complexity over fixed new-source logistic regression. This does not prove the logistic comparator is superior.

uncertainty.method: Paired date resampling and independent patient/date exponential-weight dependence sensitivity, preserving the frozen selections and a common weighted slot denominator. No refitting or reranking.
uncertainty.limits: Only eight observed dates and two ISO weeks. Intervals condition on this cohort and fitted models; sparse-cluster coverage can be unstable. Source selection, model development, snapshot and maturity uncertainty are not captured. The crossed interval is a dependence sensitivity, not a coverage guarantee.

allocation_warning: The frozen primary allocation concentrated heavily in younger adult age bands, with very little allocation to older adults. This requires review; it establishes neither fairness nor harm. Granular age-band counts, subgroup outcome cells and calibration bins are deliberately omitted, including complementary cells.

verification.scope: Independent arithmetic and paired-date resampling of frozen aggregate results. Rank and probability regressions were not rerun on final individual records; crossed intervals were read from the frozen evaluation.

publication_scope: Minimal cohort-wide aggregate facts and independently written interpretation only. No source records, individual predictions, keys, row hashes, model weights, per-date or subgroup tables, or calibration bins.
